title: Magnorolins A–L: sesquiterpenoids with diverse skeletons from the fruits of Magnolia grandiflora and their cytotoxic and anti-inflammatory activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29012-29024
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02737G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiu-Ye Zhao, Shi-Huan Yin, Xin-Ying Wang, Lu Sai, Lin-Fen Ding, Xing-De Wu
Twelve new sesquiterpenoids with diverse carbon skeleton, magnorolins A–L (1–3, 5–12, and 15), and four known analogues (4, 13, 14, and 16) were isolated from the fruits of Magnolia grandiflora.
